title: Continual Learning for Sequential Personalization of Small Language Models: A Stability Monitoring Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2606.27634v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly being considered for deployment on edge devices such as laptops, enabling private, low-latency, and locally personalized applications. However, personalization requires models to adapt over time to evolving user- or task-specific data, placing them in a continual learning setting. This creates the risk of catastrophic forgetting, where learning new information degrades performance on previously learned tasks or broader model capabilities. Recent benchmarks such as TRACE have shown that continual fine-tuning can significantly degrade the general abilities of aligned large language models. In this work, we present a study for sequential LoRA personalization of SLMs. We save model checkpoints after each adaptation stage and evaluate them on current tasks, previously seen tasks, and a fixed reference set. translated_title: 面向小语言模型序列化个性化的持续学习：一种稳定性监测分析
translated_abstract: 小语言模型（SLM）日益被考虑部署在笔记本电脑等边缘设备上，以实现私密、低延迟和本地个性化的应用。然而，个性化要求模型随时间适应不断变化的用户或任务特定数据，这使其处于持续学习的环境中。这带来了灾难性遗忘的风险，即学习新信息会降低模型在之前所学任务或更广泛模型能力上的表现。近期的基准测试（如TRACE）表明，持续微调会显著降低已对齐大型语言模型的通用能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一项针对小语言模型顺序LoRA个性化的研究。我们在每个适配阶段后保存模型检查点，并在当前任务、之前见过的任务以及固定的参考集上对其进行评估。这种检查点级别的协议使我们能够监测任务性能、遗忘情况以及……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种检查点级别的顺序LoRA个性化协议，用于监测小语言模型在边缘设备持续个性化学习过程中的任务性能、灾难性遗忘及整体能力稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a checkpoint-level protocol for sequential LoRA personalization of small language models, enabling monitoring of task performance, catastrophic forgetting, and general ability stability in continual learning on edge devices.
